reasoning: On the season so far the Hawks are the stronger team; with home court the Hawks start about 5 points better, in a game of about 231 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pacers.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Pacers (revenge).
Bottom line: the Hawks win 60 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 205 and 254 total points.
